dialogues.speaker: Veta
dialogues.text: Wanna play a game with me?

dialogues.speaker: Veta
dialogues.text: A game of guessing your savings.

dialogues.speaker: Veta
dialogues.text: I'll call out a number, and you can tell me if it's higher or lower than the correct number. Bet you I'll get it in 3 guesses.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you playing over here?

dialogues.speaker: Veta
dialogues.text: My dad's a Snezhnayan envoy who's been posted to the Northland Bank. He won't let me run too far off.

dialogues.speaker: Veta
dialogues.text: Look, that's the bank. It's between a clockwork workshop and the clock shop. Pretty awesome, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Veta
dialogues.text: My dad's taught me how to distinguish between good and bad people, so don't worry, I'm not gonna go running off with bad people.

dialogues.speaker: Veta
dialogues.text: Alright, guess I'll just play with someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Veta
dialogues.text: Huh? C'mon, don't you trust me? I won't tell anyone else, honest!

dialogues.speaker: Veta
dialogues.text: I just wanna know if I'm reading people right, you know?
